mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,employee_no,name,phone,email,avatar_url,employment_status,profile_completed,hire_date,leave_date, version,profile_version,phone_verified,email_verified,create_time,create_by,edit_time,edit_by FROM t_employee WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,login_act,name,account_enabled,account_no_locked,account_no_expired,account_expires_at,credentials_no_expired, manual_locked,auto_locked_until,password_expires_at,account_status,account_type,protected_account, version,authorization_version,auth_version FROM t_user WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_employee SET employment_status=#{toStatus},version=version+1,edit_time=#{effectiveAt},edit_by=#{operatorId}, hire_date=CASE WHEN #{setHireDate}=1 THEN DATE(#{effectiveAt}) ELSE hire_date END, leave_date=CASE WHEN #{setLeaveDate}=1 THEN DATE(#{effectiveAt}) WHEN #{setHireDate}=1 THEN NULL ELSE leave_date END WHERE id=#{employeeId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND employment_status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_id,status,NULL AS state,NULL AS version,NULL AS planned_start_time,NULL AS planned_end_time FROM t_activity WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PLANNED','ONGOING','ENDED') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT clue.id,clue.owner_id,LOWER(COALESCE(state_value.value_code,'')) AS status,clue.state,NULL AS version,NULL AS planned_start_time,NULL AS planned_end_time FROM t_clue clue LEFT JOIN t_dic_value state_value ON state_value.id=clue.state WHERE clue.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND LOWER(COALESCE(state_value.value_code,'')) NOT IN ('closed','converted') ORDER BY clue.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,owner_id,COALESCE(customer_status,'INTENTION') AS status,NULL AS state,NULL AS version,NULL AS planned_start_time,NULL AS planned_end_time FROM t_customer WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND COALESCE(customer_status,'INTENTION') NOT IN ('MERGED','INVALID') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,owner_id,stage AS status,NULL AS state,version,NULL AS planned_start_time,NULL AS planned_end_time FROM t_opportunity WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND stage NOT IN ('WON','LOST','CLOSED') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,owner_id,status,NULL AS state,version,NULL AS planned_start_time,NULL AS planned_end_time FROM t_follow_task WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS','POSTPONED','OVERDUE') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,owner_id,status,NULL AS state,version,planned_start_time,planned_end_time FROM t_test_drive WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRM','SCHEDULED','RESCHEDULED','CHECKED_IN') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_activity SET owner_id=#{toUserId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{fromUserId} AND status=#{status}
UPDATE t_clue SET owner_id=#{toUserId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{fromUserId} AND state=#{state}
UPDATE t_customer SET owner_id=#{toUserId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{fromUserId} AND COALESCE(customer_status,'INTENTION')=#{status}
UPDATE t_opportunity SET owner_id=#{toUserId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{fromUserId} AND stage=#{stage} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE t_follow_task SET owner_id=#{toUserId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{fromUserId} AND status=#{status} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE t_test_drive SET owner_id=#{toUserId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{fromUserId} AND status=#{status} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_quote quote_record INNER JOIN t_customer customer ON customer.id=quote_record.customer_id WHERE customer.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND COALESCE(customer.customer_status,'INTENTION') NOT IN ('MERGED','INVALID') AND quote_record.status NOT IN ('REFUSED','EXPIRED','VOIDED','CONVERTED_TO_ORDER')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_tran tran_record INNER JOIN t_customer customer ON customer.id=tran_record.customer_id WHERE customer.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND COALESCE(customer.customer_status,'INTENTION') NOT IN ('MERGED','INVALID') AND tran_record.stage NOT IN ('COMPLETED','LOST','CLOSED','CANCELLED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from<=#{at}) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND effective_from<=#{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at>#{at} AND absolute_expires_at>#{at}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<=#{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND assignment_type<>'PRIMARY' AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<=#{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<=#{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE manager_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<=#{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE manager_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_organization_unit WHERE leader_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND enabled=1 AND migration_placeholder=0

SELECT fact FROM ( SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','USER',id,version,authorization_version,auth_version,account_status,account_enabled, account_no_locked,account_no_expired,COALESCE(CAST(account_expires_at AS CHAR),'~'),credentials_no_expired,COALESCE(manual_locked,0),COALESCE(CAST(auto_locked_until AS CHAR),'~'), COALESCE(CAST(password_expires_at AS CHAR),'~')) fact FROM t_user WHERE id=#{userId} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','ROLE',id,role_id,version,COALESCE(CAST(effective_from AS CHAR),'~'),COALESCE(CAST(effective_to AS CHAR),'~'),COALESCE(active_marker,0)) FROM t_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','PERMISSION',id,permission_id,effect,COALESCE(data_scope_code,'~'),version,CAST(effective_from AS CHAR),COALESCE(CAST(effective_to AS CHAR),'~'),COALESCE(active_marker,0)) FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','SESSION',id,session_id,issued_auth_version,version,CAST(idle_expires_at AS CHAR),CAST(absolute_expires_at AS CHAR)) FROM t_user_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at>#{at} AND absolute_expires_at>#{at} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','ASSIGNMENT',id,organization_unit_id,position_id,assignment_type,status,version,CAST(effective_from AS CHAR),COALESCE(CAST(effective_to AS CHAR),'~')) FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','REPORTING_SELF',id,manager_employee_id,relation_type,status,version,CAST(effective_from AS CHAR),COALESCE(CAST(effective_to AS CHAR),'~')) FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','REPORTING_SUBORDINATE',id,subordinate_employee_id,relation_type,status,version,CAST(effective_from AS CHAR),COALESCE(CAST(effective_to AS CHAR),'~')) FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE manager_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{at}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','LEADER',id,code,type,version,enabled,COALESCE(migration_placeholder,0)) FROM t_organization_unit WHERE leader_employee_id=#{employeeId} AND enabled=1 AND migration_placeholder=0 ) lifecycle_fact ORDER BY fact

WITH RECURSIVE organization_ancestry(descendant_id,ancestor_id,parent_id) AS ( SELECT id,id,parent_id FROM t_organization_unit UNION ALL SELECT ancestry.descendant_id,parent.id,parent.parent_id FROM organization_ancestry ancestry INNER JOIN t_organization_unit parent ON parent.id=ancestry.parent_id ) SELECT DISTINCT employee.id AS employee_id,employee.name AS employee_name, CONCAT(employee.employee_no,' · ',organization.name,' · ',position.name) AS secondary_label FROM t_employee employee INNER JOIN t_user user_account ON user_account.id=employee.user_id AND user_account.id<>#{excludedUserId} AND user_account.account_enabled=1 AND user_account.account_no_locked=1 AND user_account.account_status='ACTIVE' AND user_account.account_no_expired=1 AND user_account.credentials_no_expired=1 AND (user_account.account_expires_at IS NULL OR user_account.account_expires_at>#{at}) AND (user_account.password_expires_at IS NULL OR user_account.password_expires_at>#{at}) AND user_account.account_type='HUMAN' AND user_account.protected_account=0 AND COALESCE(user_account.manual_locked,0)=0 AND (user_account.auto_locked_until IS NULL OR user_account.auto_locked_until<=#{at}) INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id=employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type='PRIMARY' AND assignment.status='ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker=1 AND assignment.effective_from<=#{at} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to>#{at}) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization ON organization.id=assignment.organization_unit_id AND organization.enabled=1 AND organization.migration_placeholder=0 INNER JOIN t_position position ON position.id=assignment.position_id AND position.enabled=1 AND position.code<>'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE employee.employment_status='ACTIVE'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT required.code FROM t_permission required WHERE required.enabled=1 AND required.code IN #{code} AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role user_role INNER JOIN t_role role_record ON role_record.id=user_role.role_id AND role_record.enabled=1 INNER JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id=role_record.id AND role_permission.permission_id=required.id WHERE user_role.user_id=user_account.id AND user_role.active_marker=1 AND (user_role.effective_from IS NULL OR user_role.effective_from<=#{at}) AND (user_role.effective_to IS NULL OR user_role.effective_to>#{at}) AND (role_record.scope_type='GLOBAL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_role_organization applicable INNER JOIN organization_ancestry ancestry ON ancestry.descendant_id=assignment.organization_unit_id AND ancestry.ancestor_id=applicable.organization_unit_id WHERE applicable.role_id=role_record.id )) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_permission personal WHERE personal.user_id=user_account.id AND personal.permission_id=required.id AND personal.active_marker=1 AND personal.effect='GRANT' AND personal.effective_from<=#{at} AND (personal.effective_to IS NULL OR personal.effective_to>#{at}) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_permission denied WHERE denied.user_id=user_account.id AND denied.permission_id=required.id AND denied.active_marker=1 AND denied.effect='DENY' AND denied.effective_from<=#{at} AND (denied.effective_to IS NULL OR denied.effective_to>#{at}) ) ) )
ORDER BY employee.name,employee.id

SELECT id,token_digest,user_id,employee_id,employee_version,reason_digest,fact_digest,expires_at,consumed_at,version,create_time FROM t_user_lifecycle_snapshot WHERE token_digest=#{tokenDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_lifecycle_snapshot SET consumed_at=#{consumedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>#{consumedAt}
